metadata.title: Adivasi or Vanvasi debate and History | आदिवासी या वनवासी बहस का इतिहास
metadata.description: Congress leader Rahul Gandhi recently raked up the old controversy of Adivasi or Vanvasi. The tribes of India are known as Adivasis in textbooks, literature and public discourse. The Constitution of India uses term Janjati or scheduled tribes. But RSS and it's affiliated organisations including ruling BJP uses term Vanvasi for tribals. It's an ideological question for them. In this episode we try to understand the history of this debate.
